response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced individual contributor (~19 years) with genuine developer-tooling credentials (test runners, assertion libraries, CI/CD infrastructure, MCP code generators) and some mobile exposure, but the resume shows no formal people-management experience, which is a hard requirement (2+ years) for this Level II manager role. There is also no evidence of organizational change leadership, strategic roadmap ownership, or managing performance of direct reports, making the fit for a people-leadership position weak despite strong technical depth.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience with developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, Selenium training, CI/CD and GitLab setup)
Long, varied engineering career (~19 years) spanning web, mobile, backend, and high-performance systems
Demonstrated knowledge-sharing and mentorship through workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: No formal people-management or team-leadership roles listed, a minimum requirement for the position
No evidence of leading organizational change or owning team-level roadmaps and performance management
Mobile-platform experience is limited and dated (iOS/Apple TV work ended in 2016)

key_factors.factor: Developer tooling and testing infrastructure expertise
